name: ClawFetch
description: ClawFetch turns the open web into agent-ready data: stealth page fetching, headless JS rendering, structured extraction from 17 specialized sites (Twitter/X, GitHub, CoinGecko, Hacker News, YouTube, Wikipedia, npm, PyPI, crates.io, Product Hunt, IMDb, Amazon, Crunchbase, SEC EDGAR, Zillow, Redfin, news), multi-source research, and live WHOIS domain screening. No API keys, no accounts, no subscription — pay per request in USDC on Base via the x402 protocol, from $0.001 a call.
